# Architecture & Interior Design Copywriting Guide

**When to load this skill:** Load this file whenever generating or rewriting content for architecture firms, interior design studios, or built-environment businesses. The `content-writer` agent should load this skill before producing any copy.

---

## Tone Archetypes

Match the brand voice from `static-site-ai-system/context/branding.md` to one of these archetypes. When in doubt, default to **Refined Modern**.

| Archetype | Characteristics | Sample Hero Headline |
|---|---|---|
| **Refined Modern** | Restrained, confident, typographic-led. Lets work speak. | "Architecture That Endures." |
| **Luxury Residential** | Aspirational, sensory, evocative. Warm but elevated. | "Spaces Designed for the Way You Live." |
| **Bold Commercial** | Direct, results-oriented, authoritative. | "We Build the Spaces That Define Your Brand." |
| **Sustainable/Biophilic** | Purposeful, grounded, forward-thinking. | "Design in Harmony With the World." |
| **Editorial / Studio** | Intellectual, story-driven, slightly avant-garde. | "Every Project Begins as a Question." |

## Hero Section Copy

### Subheading (`.sub-heading`) — ALL CAPS, 3–5 words
The subheading labels the business category. It must be instantly scannable.

```
ARCHITECTURE & INTERIOR DESIGN
AWARD-WINNING DESIGN STUDIO
EXPERT & INNOVATIVE
RESIDENTIAL & COMMERCIAL
TRANSFORMING SPACES SINCE [YEAR]
```

### Hero Headline Formula
Main headline: **[Verb/Adjective] + [What] + [Optional: For Whom/Where]**

Wrap 1–2 accent words in the existing `<span>` tag.

```
We Design Spaces <span>Worth Living In</span>
Architecture That <span>Transforms</span> How You Work
Building Dreams, <span>Defining Skylines</span>
Interiors That <span>Move</span> You
Where Vision Meets <span>Craft</span>
```

**Avoid:** Generic phrases ("Your trusted partner", "We are passionate about"), vague superlatives ("the best", "world-class"), passive voice ("Projects are designed by us").

### Hero Body Paragraph (`.antra-desc p`)
2–3 sentences. Structure: **What you do → How/Approach → Who for**.

```
[FIRM NAME] is a full-service architecture studio specialising in 
residential and commercial design across [CITY] and beyond.
We combine rigorous spatial thinking with a deep understanding 
of how people inhabit space — producing work that is both 
precisely crafted and genuinely liveable.
```

### Hero CTA Button
Action + benefit. Short. 3–5 words.

```
See Our Work          →  portfolio.html
Start a Project       →  contact.html
Book a Consultation   →  contact.html
View Our Services     →  service.html
Explore Our Portfolio →  portfolio.html
```

## Services Section Copy

### Section Subheading
```
WHAT WE OFFER
OUR SERVICES
OUR EXPERTISE
HOW WE HELP
```

### Section Headline Formula
**[We/Our] + [verb] + [what] + [optional: outcome]**
```
Services Tailored to <span>Every Vision</span>
What We <span>Do Best</span>
Architecture That <span>Serves You</span>
```

### Individual Service Description (2 sentences)
Formula: **[Service name] is [what it is]. [Key benefit or approach in one sentence].**

| Service | Sample Copy |
|---|---|
| Architectural Design | "Full-cycle architectural design from concept through planning and construction. We balance aesthetic ambition with structural rigour and budget reality." |
| Interior Design | "Considered interior environments that reflect how you live and who you are. From spatial planning to material selection, every detail is resolved." |
| Landscape Architecture | "Outdoor spaces designed as an extension of the building — not an afterthought. We integrate planting, light, and landform into a unified composition." |
| Project Management | "We manage the entire build process so you don't have to. Contractor coordination, programme oversight, and quality control from groundbreak to handover." |
| 3D Visualisation | "Photorealistic renders and immersive walkthroughs before a single brick is laid. Communicate design intent clearly to clients and planning authorities." |
| Renovation & Restoration | "Sensitive interventions in existing fabric — from Victorian terrace extensions to Grade II listed restorations. Heritage expertise matched with contemporary sensibility." |
| Commercial Design | "Workplaces, hospitality venues, and retail spaces that perform commercially and look exceptional. We understand that great design drives great business." |
| Residential Design | "Bespoke homes designed around the rhythms of daily life. From modest extensions to new-build family homes, crafted with equal care." |

## About Section Copy

### Subheading
Use the founding year or a milestone:
```
ESTABLISHED [YEAR]
SINCE [YEAR]
[N] YEARS OF PRACTICE
FOUNDED [YEAR]
```

### About Headline
```
A Studio <span>Built on Craft</span>
Design With <span>Purpose</span>
Architecture From <span>First Principles</span>
More Than a Firm — <span>A Practice</span>
```

### About List Items (differentiators — keep `<img>` at start of each `<li>`)
Use concrete, specific claims — not generic platitudes.

```
✓  [N]+ completed projects across [N] countries
✓  Award-winning team of [N] architects and designers  
✓  Every project led by a senior partner — no handoffs
✓  Full RIBA / AIA / ARB accreditation
✓  In-house visualisation and BIM capability
✓  Net zero design commitment since [YEAR]
```

### About Body Paragraph
```
[FIRM NAME] was founded in [YEAR] with a single conviction: that 
good architecture should be available to everyone who cares about it. 
Based in [CITY], our team of [N] architects and interior designers 
works across residential, commercial, and public sector projects — 
from [smallest project type] to [largest project type].
```

## Feature/Services List Section

### Individual Service Row Title
Short noun phrase, 3–4 words maximum:
```
Architectural Concept Design
Space Planning & Layout
Material & Finish Specification
Construction Documentation
Planning Permission Support
Interior Styling & FF&E
```

## Counter / Stats Section

### Label Formulas
Make the label contextual — not just a noun:
```
Years of Practice         (not just "Years")
Projects Delivered        (not "Projects Completed")
Countries Worked In       (not "Countries")
Industry Awards           (not "Awards")
Sq ft Designed            
Satisfied Clients
```

### Supporting Sentence
1 sentence that gives the number meaning:
```
"150+ completed projects ranging from single-room interventions to 
 mixed-use masterplans."
"From our base in London, we have worked across 12 countries on 
 four continents."
```

## Process Section Copy

### Section Subheading
```
HOW WE WORK
OUR PROCESS
FROM BRIEF TO BUILD
THE DESIGN JOURNEY
```

### Step Titles and Descriptions

| Step | Title | 2-sentence description |
|---|---|---|
| 01 | Discovery & Brief | "We begin with a thorough conversation about how you live, work, and want to feel in your space. This discovery session shapes everything that follows — ensuring the design brief truly reflects your needs." |
| 02 | Concept Design | "We develop two or three distinct design directions, exploring form, material, and spatial character. You choose the direction that resonates, and we refine it together." |
| 03 | Design Development | "The chosen concept is developed into a resolved scheme — plans, elevations, sections, and 3D visualisations. This is where the design takes its final shape before documentation begins." |
| 04 | Planning & Approvals | "We prepare and submit all planning and building regulation applications on your behalf. Our experienced team manages the process and handles any queries from authorities." |
| 05 | Technical Documentation | "Detailed construction drawings, specifications, and schedules are prepared for tender and build. These documents are the blueprint your contractor will work from." |
| 06 | Construction & Delivery | "We visit site regularly throughout construction, monitoring quality and resolving issues as they arise. We don't consider the project complete until you are delighted with the result." |

## Testimonials Section Copy

### Testimonial Formula
Structure: **[Specific outcome] + [How the team worked] + [Personal recommendation]**

```
"[FIRM NAME] transformed a tired Victorian terrace into a home 
that genuinely surprises us every day. Their attention to natural 
light was something we hadn't even thought to ask for — and now 
it's the thing we're most grateful for. We'd recommend them 
without hesitation."
— Sarah & Tom H., Homeowners, North London
```

**Avoid:** vague praise ("They were great", "Loved working with them"), no specifics.


## Vocabulary Reference

### Use These Words
```
considered · resolved · rigorous · precise · craft · spatial
bespoke · curated · composed · material · inhabit · live in
transformative · purposeful · enduring · nuanced · proportioned
```

### Avoid These Words
```
passionate · excited · dedicated · world-class · innovative (overused)
leverage · synergy · holistic (corporate clichés)
unique (say what makes it unique instead)
solutions (be specific)
journey (unless describing the process step by step)
```

---

## Localization Notes

- **UK firms:** Use "practice" not "firm", "programme" not "program", "storey" not "story", "colour" not "color"
- **US firms:** AIA accreditation, "sq ft", state abbreviations for locations
- **Middle East:** Emphasise luxury credentials, bilingual consideration (`dir="rtl"` not needed for static HTML), large-scale project experience
- **Australia:** Use sustainability/passive design language prominently, NCC compliance references
